result.summary: Found 1 likely layout issue: content at the bottom is being obscured by the fixed navigation bar. Everything else looks mostly consistent, with some horizontally scrollable cards intentionally cut off at the edges.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially hidden behind the bottom navigation bar, so its image and details are not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content or ensure the fixed tab bar does not overlap the list so the full card can be seen and tapped.
